query:
UPDATE short_link
              SET visits = visits + 1,
                  first_visit_at = COALESCE(first_visit_at, $2),
                  last_visit_at = $2
            WHERE token = $1
              AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > $2)
              AND (NOT single_use OR visits = 0)
        RETURNING target as "target!", external as "external!"
